title: CodeMimicry: Exploiting Safety Generalization Lag in Large Language Models via Structured Code Completion
abstract: arXiv:2609.39902v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models have achieved remarkable capabilities across diverse domains, yet their safety alignment remains vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. In this work, we identify a previously underexplored failure mode - safety generalization lag - where alignment trained predominantly on natural language fails to transfer to the code domain. We show that this lag induces a code-completion blind spot, allowing malicious intent embedded within syntactically valid code to evade safety mechanisms. To exploit this vulnerability, we propose CodeMimicry, a fully automated black-box jailbreak framework that generates structured, object-oriented code prompts to induce harmful outputs via code completion. Experiments on 8 state-of-the-art commercial LLMs demonstrate that CodeMimicry achieves a 96.25% attack success rate with 1.51 queries on average, significantly outperforming both template-based and optimization-based baselines. Beyond empirica

translated_title: CodeMimicry：利用结构化代码补全 exploit 大语言模型的安全泛化滞后
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在众多领域已展现出卓越能力，但其安全对齐仍然容易受到越狱攻击。在这项工作中，我们发现了一种此前未被充分研究的失效模式——安全泛化滞后，即主要基于自然语言训练的安全对齐无法迁移到代码领域。我们证明这种滞后会引发代码补全盲区，使嵌入在语法有效代码中的恶意意图能够规避安全机制。为了利用这一漏洞，我们提出了CodeMimicry，这是一个完全自动化的黑盒越狱框架，它通过生成结构化的面向对象代码提示，诱导模型在代码补全过程中产生有害输出。在8个最先进的商业大语言模型上的实验表明，CodeMimicry以平均1.51次查询实现了96.25%的攻击成功率，显著优于基于模板和基于优化的基线方法。
tldr: 该论文发现大语言模型存在“安全泛化滞后”漏洞，即自然语言训练的安全对齐无法迁移到代码领域，其提出的CodeMimicry框架利用结构化代码补全诱导有害输出，在8个商业模型上以平均1.51次查询达到96.25%的攻击成功率。
en_tdlr: CodeMimicry exploits "safety generalization lag" in LLMs—where natural-language-trained safety alignment fails to transfer to code—achieving a 96.25% attack success rate on 8 commercial models via structured object-oriented code completion prompts.
